turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Mother, you worry too much about the feast. It is all prepared as you wished, the best we could provide. Surely, you should rest now and not trouble yourself with such things.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Rest? I rest when the legacy is secure, Wang Lung. The maid possesses a certain… resilience, but she lacks the understanding of lineage that is required to raise a son who will uphold our name. See to it that she learns, or find another.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, you speak of lineage and of… understanding. It is a great burden, yes, but the eldest son is strong, and he will learn what is needed. Let us not speak of such things now; focus on your comfort, please.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: The eldest son possesses strength, yes, but strength without wisdom is merely brute force. Ensure he understands that the land we hold, the respect we command, is earned through more than simply existing, Wang Lung. See that he studies the accounts, the workings of the estate; lineage demands more than just a strong back.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She is right to be concerned, Father. I will endeavor to study the accounts more diligently. It is… a responsibility I understand.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is good that you see it so, my son. Your mother… she always had a keen eye for these matters, didn’t she? Let us trust that you will remember her words, and that all will be well.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will, Father. I will do my best to ensure she understands what is needed. It is… important for the family’s future.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, my son, your best is all we ask. Your mother… she worries so, you see. Let us all strive to make her feel at peace, and trust that the future will unfold as it should.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: The maid is a good match, Father. I trust she will bring happiness to the household, and contribute to the family’s prosperity. It is… reassuring to see such a bright future.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your assurances are… customary, my son. Prosperity is not merely a matter of a well-matched wife; it is diligence and foresight that secure a legacy. Ensure she understands the burden she carries, and that her happiness is secondary to the family’s wellbeing.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She is correct, Father. I will ensure the maid understands her responsibilities. It is… a great privilege to contribute to the family’s continued success.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Indeed, my son, your mother speaks with wisdom, as always. We all wish for a strong and prosperous family, and it is good to have such dedication. Let us hope she finds some comfort in knowing her wishes will be carried out, and that all will be well.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will do my best to guide her, Mother. It is my duty to ensure the family's stability and maintain your legacy.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father speaks of hope, and it is a pleasant delusion. But remember, my son, hope is a fragile thing, easily shattered by the harsh realities of this world. See to it that your wife understands that survival demands more than mere wishful thinking; it demands relentless effort and a ruthless pragmatism.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Yes, Mother. I understand. I will impress upon her the importance of… practicality.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: The maid possesses a certain… resilience. Ensure she learns to manage the household with an unwavering hand, my son; sentimentality is a luxury we can no longer afford. See that she understands the weight of her position, and that she bears it without complaint.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is… a good thing you are thinking of these matters, my son. Your mother… she always has had a sharp eye for what is needed, hasn't she? Let us all strive to heed her words, and may the ancestors guide us.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She is very wise, Mother. I will certainly relay your instructions to the maid; she will benefit from your guidance. We are all grateful for your foresight.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father speaks of guidance from the ancestors, a comforting notion, but remember, my son, lineage is not guaranteed by prayers alone. Ensure your wife understands that the continuation of our line rests not upon divine intervention, but upon her ability to bear healthy sons—sons who are strong and possess a shrewd understanding of the land.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Yes, Mother. I will, of course, speak with her about that. It is… important for the family’s future.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Now she will be well, yet!

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
